-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies connectivity to backend.

list-agents.name: list-agents
list-agents.description: List agents owned by the user or in their workspaces.

params.workspaceId: Optional: Filter agents by workspace ID. If not provided, lists all accessible agents.

get-agent.name: get-agent
get-agent.description: Get detailed information about a specific agent.

create-agent.name: create-agent
create-agent.description: Create a new agent instance. The core is assigned automatically by scope (no workspace → super-agent; workspace → agent).

params.name: Short name for the agent (e.g., 'Alice')
params.fullName: Full name for the agent (e.g., 'Alice Evergreen')
params.workspaceId: Optional: Workspace ID to create the agent in. If not provided, creates a global agent. Pass null explicitly to create a Superagent (a global agent with elevated capabilities not bound to any workspace).

params.name: New short name
params.avatarUrl: URL of the agent avatar image
params.context: Agent-specific context that gets injected into the system prompt. Use this to provide agent-specific instructions, guidelines, or knowledge. Supports markdown.

delete-agent.name: delete-agent
delete-agent.description: Delete an agent. This also removes all app access grants for the agent.

list-agent-apps.name: list-agent-apps
list-agent-apps.description: List all apps an agent has access to.

get-agent-providers.name: get-agent-providers
get-agent-providers.description: Get the LLM provider configuration for an agent. Returns the agent's available providers, preferred provider, and selected model.

set-agent-providers.name: set-agent-providers
set-agent-providers.description: Set the available LLM providers for an agent. This determines which providers the agent can use. Requires workspace access or agent ownership.

params.providerIds: Array of provider IDs to make available to this agent

set-agent-preferred-provider.name: set-agent-preferred-provider
set-agent-preferred-provider.description: Set the preferred LLM provider for an agent. The provider must be in the agent's available providers list. Pass null to clear the preference.

params.providerId: Provider ID to set as preferred (must be in availableProviders), or null to clear

list-workspaces.name: list-workspaces
list-workspaces.description: List workspaces the user owns or is a member of.

get-workspace.name: get-workspace
get-workspace.description: Get detailed information about a specific workspace.

create-workspace.name: create-workspace
create-workspace.description: Create a new workspace with its own volume.

update-workspace.name: update-workspace
update-workspace.description: Update workspace properties including the context that gets injected into agent system prompts.

params.name: New name
params.context: Context text that gets injected into agent system prompts. Use this to provide project-specific information, guidelines, coding standards, or any other context that agents should know. Supports markdown and can be long (multiple paragraphs).

archive-workspace.name: archive-workspace
archive-workspace.description: Archive a workspace (soft delete). Only the owner can archive.

add-workspace-member.name: add-workspace-member
add-workspace-member.description: Add a member to a workspace.

remove-workspace-member.name: remove-workspace-member
remove-workspace-member.description: Remove a member from a workspace.

update-workspace-member-role.name: update-workspace-member-role
update-workspace-member-role.description: Update a member's role in a workspace.

list-apps.name: list-apps
list-apps.description: List apps owned by the user.

params.workspaceId: Optional: Filter apps by workspace ID. If not provided, lists all apps owned by the user across all workspaces.

get-app.name: get-app
get-app.description: Get detailed information about a specific app.

install-app.name: install-app
install-app.description: Install an MCA from the catalog as an app. The installed app is auto-granted to the user's superagents. Apps are scoped to a workspace: their tools are only available in conversations of that workspace.

params.name: Optional: Custom name for the app (lower-kebab-case). Auto-generated if not provided.
params.workspaceId: Optional: Workspace ID to install the app in. Defaults to the user's Private Workspace. To use the app's tools in the current conversation, install it in the conversation's workspace.

uninstall-app.name: uninstall-app
uninstall-app.description: Uninstall an app. This also removes all agent access grants.

check-app-auth.name: check-app-auth
check-app-auth.description: Check an app's authentication status (connected, expired, missing credentials, not required) without showing anything to the user. Use it to verify auth before or after operating an app. If the status is broken, use show-app-auth so the user can fix it from the chat — never ask for credentials directly.

params.appId: The app whose authentication status to check

show-app-auth.name: show-app-auth
show-app-auth.description: Show an app's authentication widget to the user, inline in the chat, so they can connect or re-authenticate it right there (e.g. reconnect Gmail when the OAuth session expired). Use it when an app's tools fail for auth reasons (expired session, missing credentials). Returns the app's current auth status so you can tell the user what needs fixing. Never ask the user for credentials directly — the widget is the only place they should enter them.

params.appId: The app whose authentication section to show

list-app-access.name: list-app-access
list-app-access.description: List all agents that have access to an app.

params.workspaceId: The workspace ID to list apps for
The workspace ID to list agents for

list-catalog.name: list-catalog
list-catalog.description: List all MCAs available in the catalog.

list-providers.name: list-providers
list-providers.description: List all LLM providers available to the user. Returns providers with their models, status, and configuration.

grant-app-access.name: grant-app-access
grant-app-access.description: Grant an agent access to an app.

params.agentId: The agent to grant access to
params.appId: The app to grant access to

revoke-app-access.name: revoke-app-access
revoke-app-access.description: Revoke an agent's access to an app.

params.agentId: The agent to revoke access from
params.appId: The app to revoke access to

get-app-permissions.name: get-app-permissions
get-app-permissions.description: Get the tool permissions of an app: each tool's configured permission ('allow' runs without asking, 'ask' requires user confirmation, 'forbid' is blocked), its manifest flags (readOnly, alwaysAsk), and a summary.

params.appId: The app whose permissions to read

set-app-permissions.name: set-app-permissions
set-app-permissions.description: Set tool permissions for an app, in batch. Values: 'allow' (runs without asking), 'ask' (requires user confirmation), 'forbid' (blocked), 'default' (clear the explicit setting so the tool falls back to the app default). Use `tools` for per-tool changes and/or `all` to change every tool at once; `all: 'default'` resets the whole app to defaults.

params.appId: The app whose permissions to change
params.all: Set every tool of the app at once; 'default' resets all tools to the app default
params.tools: Per-tool changes: a map of tool name to 'allow' | 'ask' | 'forbid' | 'default'. Applied on top of `all` when both are given.

skill-list.name: skill-list
skill-list.description: List all skills in a workspace.

params.workspaceId: The workspace ID to list skills from

skill-create.name: skill-create
skill-create.description: Create a new skill in a workspace.

params.workspaceId: The workspace ID to create the skill in
params.name: Name of the skill
params.content: Markdown content / instructions for the skill

params.name: New name for the skill
params.content: New Markdown content / instructions for the skill

skill-delete.name: skill-delete
skill-delete.description: Delete a skill and all its agent access entries.

skill-grant-access.name: skill-grant-access
skill-grant-access.description: Assign a skill to an agent.

params.agentId: The agent ID to assign the skill to

skill-revoke-access.name: skill-revoke-access
skill-revoke-access.description: Remove a skill assignment from an agent.

params.agentId: The agent ID to remove the skill from

skill-set-enabled.name: skill-set-enabled
skill-set-enabled.description: Enable or disable a skill for a specific agent.

params.enabled: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) the skill for the agent

skill-get-agent-skills.name: skill-get-agent-skills
skill-get-agent-skills.description: Get all skills assigned to an agent.

params.agentId: The agent ID to get skills for

name: Teros Core
description: Manage Teros platform resources: agents, workspaces, apps, and access control. Provides tools to create, update, and configure the platform.
tagline: Manage every Teros resource — agents, workspaces, apps and access — from one place.

changelog.notes: Initial release — create and manage agents, workspaces, apps, and skills, with member roles and access control
